description: This is a Java source file defining an Android activity class named QuickContactsDemo. It manages displaying a list of contacts with quick contact badges, querying the Contacts provider, and binding contact data to list item views.

classes.name: QuickContactsDemo
classes.description: An Android ListActivity that displays contacts with quick contact badges, querying the Contacts provider and binding data to views.

classes.name: ContactListItemAdapter
classes.description: A ResourceCursorAdapter subclass used to bind contact data from a cursor to list item views.

classes.name: ContactListItemCache
classes.description: A cache holder for view components in each list item: name TextView and photo QuickContactBadge, along with a buffer for the contact name.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, performs a contacts query, and sets up the list adapter with the contacts cursor.

methods.name: bindView
methods.description: Binds data from cursor to the view components, setting contact name and assigning contact URI to the contact badge.

methods.name: newView
methods.description: Creates a new list item view and initializes its cache of view components.
